title: S5 does not pin the E29 mid-flight rule — at_node vs heading is indistinguishable
detail: S5 draws no 3->4, so candidate 1->3 dead-ends: preview_compute returns false whether start is at_node (0) or heading (1). Deleting the on_edge->heading branch would still pass 7/7. The stated upstream-only candidate is never constructed.
recommended_fix: Pre-draw 3->4 and make the candidate complete a route reachable from the packet's origin but not its heading (e.g. candidate 0->3): buggy at_node start fires, correct heading start stays negative.

title: The round's HIGH glow-buffer fix and the app acceptance surfaces have zero automated pins
detail: The 2-hunter HIGH fix (preview_copy deep copy), tier cycling, nudge once-latch, glow_until/gen gating, Off-mode contract, and assist_config_load fallbacks have no automated check; the new gate pins only preview data. The harness already links render, so pins are feasible.
recommended_fix: Add a harness verb pinning preview_copy isolation (mutate src after copy; dst unchanged) and assist_config_load fallback branches; track the app-glue surfaces (toggle/nudge/glow lifecycle) as a follow-up headless e2e.

title: Sim-cost cross-check shares the preview's edge-pricing scan — cost comparison is tautological for unpinned topologies
detail: check_min_cost duplicates the production scan verbatim, so sim_cost vs prev.cost cannot catch a shared mispricing. The hardcoded expected totals (20/10/15/20) anchor covered scenarios to the ladder; other topologies have no independent cost oracle.
recommended_fix: Acceptable given the hardcoded ladder anchors; to harden, assert each scenario's per-edge costs against the ladder (not just totals), or compare against a routing-table-exposed dist if ever added.

title: The mutation-test negative control (corrupt cost -> 3 reds) is a manual local run, not committed
evidence:
+      # Job B (readability package): the R2a what-if preview must equal the
+      # sim's own routing once the candidate draw commits (preview DAG edge
+      # set + cost + tie splits vs the rebuilt table + the packet's actual
+      # hash-picked path). The negative control is a local run; CI pins the
+      # green path.
detail: The PR body claims "corrupting the preview cost -> 3 reds" was verified, but no hook or script exists, so no one else can re-run it. The three scenario negatives (S4/S5/S7) are in CI; the mutation probe is not.
recommended_fix: Commit the mutation probe (e.g. a harness env/build hook that perturbs min_bundle_cost) or reword the comment so the locally-run control is not implied automated.
